summary: Recent updates in the Firefox browser’s video colour conversion system have optimized how the browser handles formats like YCbCr, which is commonly used in video. This change ensures that the conversion to RGB (the standard colour format for screens) is only performed using a deprecated method when it can actually run faster due to available assembly code. This adjustment matters because it helps improve the performance of video playback, offering a smoother experience when watching videos that utilize this colour format. **Users can expect enhanced efficiency in video rendering without sacrificing quality.**
